coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Airbnb

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your ad describes Workplace Ops teams that each run their own processes, tools and vendors, with effort duplicated and handoffs breaking down. I know a small version of that problem. Month-end close reporting at Calder Industrial Components took 9 working days because journal checks were manual, so I automated them in Excel VBA and brought it down to 6.

That is how I work: map how the process really runs, find the manual friction, and build the fix. As a Financial Analyst I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units, and I build Power BI dashboards on SAP data for plant managers, which means turning data into measurement that non-finance colleagues act on. I rebuilt a forecast model around order backlog and lifted accuracy for the larger unit from 88% to 96%. I haven't run global programs or managed vendors, and I won't pretend otherwise. My background is analytical: five years of budgeting, forecasting and month-end reporting, with the measurement frameworks and business-case thinking your transformation work depends on.

I'd welcome a conversation about how that analytical grounding could support the operational modernization roadmap for the San Francisco team. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
